report.summary: No blocking findings; typecheck not run. The change fixes test races and one image permission. (1) Dockerfile: the new `chmod 0755 /opt/tempo /opt/tempo/pi` runs as root before USER tempo, so the tempo user can open the folder that holds the pi extension at the path in docs/01. (2) conversations.cases.ts: the R2 put spy now fails only the transcript key (w.key = conversationKey(projectId, workspaceId), the key saveConversation writes), passes every other put to the real binding, and restores in finally. (3) ops.test.ts: a promise the test releases replaces sleep(300); the checks while the op runs wait for observable state; the gate is released in finally; the removed check of timings >= 250 ms is still covered by the step-timeout test (timings >= 200). Open non-blocking question: Promise.withResolvers is an ES2024 API and apps/tempo/tsconfig.json sets lib ES2023. Typecheck could not run because no node_modules is installed in any worktree.

findings.text: Promise.withResolvers is an ES2024 library API, but apps/tempo/tsconfig.json sets lib to ES2023, worker-runtime.d.ts does not declare it, and no other file in the repo uses it. TypeScript 7.0.2 may report TS2550 unless @types/node or @types/bun declares it and gets pulled in through imports. Not confirmed: no node_modules is installed, so `bun run typecheck` could not run. Running it settles this; if it fails, use a manual deferred promise (let release; new Promise(r => release = r)).

evidence.why: tsconfig.json has "lib": ["ES2023", "DOM", "DOM.Iterable"]; withResolvers is declared in lib.es2024.promise, so typecheck can fail if no included type package adds it.

findings.text: The folder-mode fix has no regression check in test:tempod:container. A test that confirms the tempo user can read /opt/tempo/pi/tempo-profile.ts would stop this from coming back. Not blocking.

evidence.why: No test in container/ or docs references these folder modes; git grep for /opt/tempo finds only the Dockerfile, Dockerfile.test and the docs.

checked.risk: Real contracts (R2 put spy key matches the key the delete path writes; unlinkProject path)
Failure paths (spy restored in finally; gate released in finally so a failed check cannot hang the op)
Tests: sleeps and timing checks replaced with observable state; shared spies under concurrent cases (conversations cases run one at a time); timing coverage kept by the step-timeout test
Build and runtime environment (folder modes and owners, user that runs processes, test image install -d, TS lib target)
Spec (pi extension path and loading in 01 Runtime and Agents; implementation notes)
Security and idempotency (no production code, secrets or op steps changed)
